name: ÅLHULT with its bench against the bottom wall, BESTÅ floating on the right wall
notes:
No junior chair since 2026-10-26 (Andrew: Maddie, almost 5, sits on a regular chair).
The top side is open to the living room (Andrew, 2026-10-24) as well as the left side to the kitchen, so both 30-inch walkways stay clear (F-42): every floor piece stands at x 30 or more and y 30 or more, nothing hangs on either open side, and rugs run under the walkways.
The bench moves from the top wall, which is now open, to the bottom wall: the ÅLHULT (ash veneer) turned across the room against its matching bench, which needs no pull-out room. Set for six as placed with the table closed: the bench (two, with the wall behind them), a SANDSBERG and Maddie's URBAN on the living-room side, one SANDSBERG at the kitchen end and one at the right end, under the floating cabinet. Until the final audit 2026-10-26 Maddie sat at that end: her head was level with the cabinet's push-open doors, 4.75" behind her chair, and she could climb from its back onto the cabinet (F-21), so she moved to the living-room side, where a parent can stand behind her.
F-36: the living-room side has 73.4" to the living-room line, the kitchen end 48.5" to the kitchen line (both passing sides), the right end 32.25" to the right wall and 23.6" to the cabinet's face (tight:23.6: the chair there pushes back 4.75" short of it, and its 30 3/8" back clears the cabinet's 33" underside), and the bench side needs none. Leaf in (66 7/8"), the table opens 9.8" at each end, so on guest nights slide the opened table right with its kitchen end staying at x 48.5 (12.6" from the other end to the wall, the pendant 9.8" off center that night): two SANDSBERG and the URBAN on the living-room side, two on the bench, one at the kitchen end and nobody at the right end, so no chair stands in the kitchen walkway (F-42).
Diners on the bench face the living room across the table; the BLODFLÄDER on the right wall is seen down the room from the kitchen.
Final audit 2026-10-26: Maddie's chair and the right-end SANDSBERG swapped places (above), the bench's wall lamp moved up to about 66", and the leaf-in seating slides the table instead of putting a chair in the walkway. The HAVSRIS cord is 15' 5" (185"): with the ceiling unmeasured, check for a ceiling box first, and measure the ceiling and find the bottom wall's outlets before buying it (its drop and run need about 171" at a 96" ceiling and about 195" at 108", F-23).
